performance.verdict: Paid channels dead 28 days; organic erosion now threatens renewal scoreboard.

findings.text: Zero paid spend and zero leads across all 28 days — Meta and Google Ads are fully paused, generating $0 CPL with no volume at all.
OVERDUE: Dashboard live milestone (2026-08-31) and 'August scoreboard trusted — renewal decision' (2026-08-31) both missed; client's stay/walk decision is now unresolved with no data to show.

OVERDUE: Phone-match attribution gap (2026-08-07) and sync/contact cleanup (2026-08-14) also missed; 106 GHL opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments recorded — intake pipeline is unverifiable.
GBP actions fell 50% week-over-week (221 over 28 days, 0 in last 3 days of series); Search Console clicks dropped 52% — organic discovery is collapsing with no paid backstop.
GA4 sessions held loosely (13, 19, 8 last 3 days vs 14, 4, 6 prior 3) but with 0 GA4 conversions over 28 days, web traffic is not converting — tracking or form may be broken.

suggestions.text: Deliver dashboard and scoreboard report immediately; client's renewal decision is past due with 0 attributable leads shown.
suggestions.monday_update: The client's stay/walk renewal decision was tied to a dashboard going live by 2026-08-31 — that milestone is missed. GHL shows 106 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments, making the scoreboard untrustworthy without the attribution and sync fixes also overdue since Aug 7 and Aug 14. Deliver the dashboard and a written scoreboard summary to Dr. Jamal and Lily by 2026-09-07. Success check: client acknowledges receipt and confirms the data reflects their OpenDental records.

suggestions.text: Investigate GA4 conversion tracking — 0 conversions over 28 days with 312 sessions signals a broken form or pixel.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 recorded 312 sessions and 253 users over 28 days but 0 conversions, which is inconsistent with any functioning contact or booking form. Audit the GA4 goal/event setup and the website form submission path by 2026-09-07. Success check: at least one test conversion fires and appears in GA4 within 48 hours of the fix.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions recovery — 0 recorded last 3 days; confirm data gap vs real drop before diagnosing further.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 for the last 3 days of the series (Sep 1–3) after averaging roughly 8–11/day earlier in August, and the 7-day delta is -50%. This could be a data reporting lag or a genuine organic visibility drop alongside the 52% Search Console decline. Re-check GBP and Search Console figures on 2026-09-07 to confirm direction before recommending any content or SEO action.
